result.prompt: A close, calm portrait at a bright window seat. An ordinary woman in her forties, in a rust-coloured knit, holds a flat white with fine clean fern latte art. She looks slightly left of the camera, mouth open as if mid-sentence. Airy daylight, pale walls, a cream coffee bag on the seat beside her. No grey clothing. Tall photograph. Keep people, cups, and the bag in the middle band. Leave quiet space above and below so the photo can later crop to 9:16 without cutting a face or the cup. Natural Scandinavian daylight, the kind in a real Danish home, a small café, or the Aarhus roastery. Shot on a normal camera, a little imperfect, quiet and specific. Not a stock photo, not glossy advertising, not CGI, and not a catalog render. Any person is an ordinary adult, varied and natural, caught mid-action rather than posing. Not a recognizable real person, not a celebrity, and not a model on a set. No real brand logos, no clothing logos, no shop signs, and no nameplates. The coffee bag is always the same bag: a matte cream paper coffee bag with a deep green rectangular label that is only a solid color block, and a small blank cream sticker where a roast date would go. The label and the sticker have no writing at all. No text anywhere in the photograph: no letters, no numbers, no words, no logos, no watermarks, no brand names, no readable labels, no captions, and no interface copy. No grey sweaters and no grey clothing.
